title: Fix Gadget Display in Panel and Config Menu
instructions: Fix the issue where only one gadget (test_gadget) is visible in the gadget config menu, and gadget buttons are not showing in the panel. Ensure all 3 enabled gadgets (hello_world, test_gadget, notices) are properly displayed with working buttons.

1784834730.4098685.instruction: Check run.py display_gadgets method to see if buttons are being created but perhaps with wrong colors (same as background) or not packed properly. Verify the gadget frame is visible and buttons are actually being added.

1784834733.8666446.instruction: Examine GadgetConfigWindow in src/gadgets.py to understand why only one gadget is shown in the configuration menu when 3 are enabled.

1784834736.8022976.instruction: Apply fixes for both issues and verify all gadgets are visible in both the panel and config menu.
